CORRECTION 2 (the reviewer conceded unverifiable specifics that ARE verifiable, and they are favorable): the US FTC cleared 2026-05-05; only Canada's Competition Bureau remains, reviewing since May with Dovigi guiding 3–5 months on the 2026-04-30 call (i.e. Aug–Oct); the outside date is 2026-11-01, extendable up to 90 days for regulatory approvals — a bounded, dated window, not open-ended. THE CUT (why 5, not 6): the thesis's engine — "+12–15% accretion is EXCLUDED from guidance" — is a bookkeeping convention masquerading as hidden information. Every acquirer excludes unclosed deals; GFL published the 12–15% figure in the April 13 release and has been headlining "significant likely upside from SECURE" since. This is the single most-telegraphed number in the story, public and sell-side-modeled for four months. So the claim "the market priced the dilution and none of the accretion" is asserted, never demonstrated. The parsimonious read of a stock 6% below pre-announcement is that the market IS pricing something real: Competition Bureau risk on a Western-Canadian waste consolidation by a serial consolidator the Bureau has already reviewed once (Terrapure), a ~25% share-issuance overhang, leverage re-levering to low-to-mid 3s after GFL spent 2025 deleveraging, a Q2 miss ($0.14 vs $0.17 est, $162.6M net loss from continuing ops), and — decisive for attack (6) — a mix shift toward SECURE's oil-and-gas-levered energy waste, a structurally more cyclical and lower-multiple stream than GFL's solid-waste core. The ~$47 / +13.6% residual is a CONSTANT-MULTIPLE pro-forma: it converts company-stated FCF/sh accretion 1:1 into share price while assuming the multiple survives a deterioration in earnings quality. That assumption is the entire residual and it is unearned. Note also the 0.4195 exchange ratio is fixed, so the quoted accretion was struck at April share prices. Instrument framing is right (acquirer common, NYSE/TSX, $14.1B cap, ~3.0M sh/day — fully tradeable, no hidden disqualifier), and the $50 take-private chatter is correctly zero-weighted (Seeking Alpha 2026-07-27 explicitly says no formal offer exists). Genuine signed-unfired event with a hard date and no run-up, but the mispricing is a discount for real risks, not a blind spot.
